self_review_mechanism.loop: Search -> Classify -> Count -> Review: هل غطيت كل الجوانب؟ هل أتممت كل المهام؟ هل صنفتها بشكل صحيح؟ -> If coverage <95% refine query
self_review_mechanism.validation: Each pattern must have id, name, detection, examples, sources, confidence. Each file must have arxiv, github, huggingface, wikipedia, commercial
self_review_mechanism.anti_stop: counter patterns <15 triggers continuation, checklist source types >=3 per file
